speaker: Doctor

The normal lateral neck X-ray makes vascular rings or webs less likely, so I need to rule out structural airway issues. Does the stridor change in quality or intensity when the infant is asleep versus awake, and is there any history of choking or cyanosis during feeds?

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the laryngoscopy is normal, this points toward a dynamic airway obstruction distal to the larynx, likely extrinsic compression given the positional nature. REQUEST TEST: Barium Swallow
